description: Fetches Beatles discography data and release information from beatlesbible.com, including UK release listings, individual release details with tracklists, and release search functionality.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_discography: 获取英国发行列表，无需其他参数; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_release: 获取特定发行的详细信息，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - search_releases: 按名称搜索发行，需要query参数; 参数: query; 必填: query

url.description:
get_release功能需要的发行页面URL。可以是完整URL或相对路径。
示例: "https://www.beatlesbible.com/1966/08/05/uk-single-eleanor-rigby-yellow-submarine/"
      或 "/1966/08/05/uk-single-eleanor-rigby-yellow-submarine/"

query.description:
search_releases功能需要的搜索关键词，用于在发行列表中查找匹配项。
示例: "Eleanor Rigby", "Abbey Road", "Sgt Pepper"
